name: Digi International Inc.
summary: Digi International Inc. provides business and mission-critical Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity products, services, and solutions in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It operates through IoT Products & Services, and IoT Solutions segments.
